verdict.rationale: Sentry's code-mappings docs say mappings link stack trace paths to source paths in your repository. They enable source context, suspect commits, stack trace linking and code owners, which covers the core of the story. Separate doc entries cover Suspect Commits, Ownership Rules and Associate Commits. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the source-control integration that connects repos (e.g. GitHub/GitLab setup), confirmation that stack-frame links resolve to the exact line on the default branch, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
